title: Chapter 198
text:
The weather was sunny, and in a place that looked like a military camp in Stardragon, many players were streaming in and out like a small market.

Stardragon's attitude toward the players was gentler. They held many internal meetings and tried to command the players. They found that they could communicate normally with normal people, but some of the Inhumans seemed to have some mental issues. However, it was not a big deal. In the end, they decided to form a special unit for the players to serve in the army.

This military camp was an area specially opened for the players. Stardragon's officers gave missions here, and many players set up stalls and asked to form teams. Gradually, the camp became prosperous.

Due to Han Xiao's influence, many players chose to join Stardragon, including Maple Moon.

Fighting and killing were not Maple Moon's cup of tea. She liked to collect all kinds of materials, build machines, and sell them to other players. Many players liked to come to her for supplies and repairs, so when doing missions, Maple Moon could easily find a team and was very popular.

Maple Moon was only a casual player, and she spent less time online than other players. She preferred to enjoy the game and would not do missions mechanically. She liked to pester the NPCs and ask them questions, which wasted a lot of time.

Even so, with the help of the prize-pool mission that Han Xiao gave her, she still surpassed most players and became one of the top few players in terms of level.

In a tent, Maple Moon looked at her experience bar and was very excited.

"Almost LV 20, I will be able to find Black Phantom soon."

…

A cold wind blew across the wasteland. Thin snow was scattered everywhere, and the bare ground was gray and white.

In a flat wasteland in the Northern Continent, a player wearing an animal skin coat was slowly trekking in the cold wind. At the end of the horizon behind him was a novice village. He was leaving the novice village.

His fists were covered in blood, and a hundred meters behind him were the corpses of seven Frost Wolves.

Frost Wolves were a common predator in the Northern Continent, and they were around LV 10. Facing seven Frost Wolves, a normal player at this stage had less than a twenty percent chance of winning. However, this player only had a few shallow claw marks on his body.

The ID above his head was' Hao Tian ', and it was obvious that it was an old ID.

Hao Tian, a famous pro god, the pillar of Club Long Sky, a veteran who had been in the pro scene for many years. He had also used this ID for many years.

There were many clubs in the Chinese eSports scene, but only four of them were known as the top clubs. They were Temple of God, Long Sky, Dynasty, and Fried Eggplants with Fish … It seemed like something strange had been mixed in, but that club was indeed called Fried Eggplants with Fish, and its archenemy was Korea's Kimchi Club.

Hao Tian suddenly received a long-distance communication request from Farewell Song and stopped in his tracks.

"Hmm?" This question perfectly reflected Haotian's characteristic of not liking nonsense.

Li Ge said, "Have you heard? The Esports Association has confirmed the formation of the Galaxy Pro League."

"Oh."

"What profession did you change to?"

"Martial Dao."

"I am a psychic." Li Ge said, "Hurry up and level up your accounts. The situation of the Chinese players is not good. I need help to deal with the foreign players."

"Mind your own business." Hao Tian hung up the call without hesitation.

They were both gods, but Li Ge's style was completely different from his.

Hao Tian had been in the pro scene for many years. He had trained steadily to get to where he was today. He did not like to talk, and he did not like to manage his public image. He was completely focused on shining in the pro scene.

Li Ge was very passionate about managing his own image. He often attended shows, and his fan base was dozens of times larger than Hao Tian's. He was also very handsome and had a lot of female fans. Furthermore, Li Ge was the kind of genius who could surpass others without much effort.

Every pro player had talent, and Li Ge was full of it.

Some people were just geniuses, and there was no room for reasoning.

Many people admired Li Ge, and many people were jealous of him. Hao Tian did not belong to the two. He had known Li Ge for a long time, and he did not have any other feelings. In his eyes, Li Ge was just a strong peer, and he did not care about other factors.

Li Ge was also his old rival, and Hao Tian had lost to him many times. This time, in order to achieve more in Galaxy, he basically spent the entire day leveling up his account. He did not want to miss any opportunity.

Hao Tian opened the forums out of habit and saw the posts of players uploading Han Xiao's main mission.

He suddenly stopped, turned around, and walked back to the Novice Village.

With Hao Tian's strength, the Novice Village was useless to him, but for Black Phantom's mission, he was willing to wait.

…

Stardragon, underground of the Dragon Horn Building, Division 13 headquarters.

In the deep metal corridor leading to the mainframe, red dots flashed in the gaps of the steel walls. Infrared detectors covered the entire corridor, and the floor was equipped with devices to identify weight and footprints.

Gu Hui entered the passcode at the door, and his pupils, fingerprints, and voice were detected. He stepped into the corridor, and in less than a second, the mainframe recognized Gu Hui's identity through the floor and infrared detectors.

"Authorization verified. Welcome, Director." A synthetic mechanical voice sounded, indifferent and emotionless.

All the defense devices went into hibernation mode, and the green light was on. Gu Hui walked into the spacious mainframe operation room with a serious face. He was there with the order from the highest leader to consult Godora, which was far away in the depths of the universe, about the inhuman phenomenon.

This was a matter of great importance, and all the surveillance cameras in the mainframe room were pointed at him. The leaders were watching.

Gu Hui knew that not only Stardragon, but other countries would also do the same. The inhuman phenomenon was too strange, and they had no solution at all. They could only seek help from galactic civilizations. Godora was the only advanced civilization they had come into contact with, and they were neutral and friendly. They had never interfered with Blue Star.

Gu Hui turned on the mainframe, entered a long series of passwords, and unlocked all the encryption. He then opened the bottom layer of the program and entered a secret code, which activated a secret program.

The screen suddenly turned white, and then a new interface popped up. It was simple and plain, and there were countless options listed on it. However, they were all gray and could not be selected. The names were all strange symbols — these were the words of the Godora civilization.

There was only one option that could be activated, and it was translated into Blue Star's language.

Communication window between Godora Sector 9 and Blue Star

This was a Sector 9 communication terminal model called 'Light Feather-8'. The six regimes of Blue Star had all received interstellar communicators from Godora and could connect with other galactic civilizations. Blue Star's technology had not yet been able to figure out the principle of how the interstellar communication terminal could send and receive signals. It seemed to be a very mature quantum entanglement communication technology.

Godora had locked many functions of the terminal and closed hundreds of communication network links to the outside universe. Blue Star could only communicate with Godora's base in Sector 9, and Blue Star could only use one-millionth or one-millionth of the interstellar communication terminal. They could only understand the structure of the universe through Godora.

However, Blue Star had no choice.

Gu Hui calmed himself down and clicked on the option. The ten seconds of waiting felt like hours. Finally, the screen flashed, and a dialog box appeared.

"Human from Blue Star, why do you want to communicate?" The cold Godora language on the other side suddenly turned into Blue Star language. This was the translation function of the terminal.

Gu Hui went through the script that he had prepared in advance in his mind and typed it word by word. "Friend of Godora, I am the person in charge of the Blue Star's Stardragon Intelligence Agency. This communication is to inquire about a strange phenomenon that has occurred on our planet. We call it the Inhuman Phenomenon. The details are as follows …" Gu Hui briefly explained their research on the Inhumans and sent detailed research files and records. In the end, he wrote, "We are unable to find the cause with our technology. We hope that you can solve the problem. If you can lend us a hand, we will express our sincere gratitude. Godora and Stardragon will always be close friends."
